\begin{document}

\section{Setup}
\label{sec:setup}
A point mass $m$ on a spring of stiffness $k$ has the Lagrangian
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:lagrangian}
L = \frac{1}{2} m \dot{x}^2 - \frac{1}{2} k x^2 .
\end{equation}

\section{Equation of motion}
\label{sec:motion}
The Euler--Lagrange equation of (\ref{eq:lagrangian}) is
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:motion}
m \ddot{x} = - k x ,
\end{equation}
with the general solution
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:solution}
x(t) = A \cos(\omega t + \varphi), \qquad \omega = \sqrt{k/m} .
\end{equation}

\section{Energy}
\label{sec:energy}
On the solution (\ref{eq:solution}) the energy
$E = \frac{1}{2} m \dot{x}^2 + \frac{1}{2} k x^2$ is constant,
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:energy}
E = \frac{1}{2} k A^2 ,
\end{equation}
because $m \omega^2 = k$.
